text:
tessa: quick checkin on RBAC batching fairness — prototype in my branch. main goal: avoid heavy tenant hogging small-panel batches

marco: can you summarize the fairness rule?

tessa: executor calculates per-tenant token_budget and dynamic headway. rule: if tenant used > 60% of last-second capacity, deprioritize for next 200ms to let small tenants through

jordan: how does that interact with leases? leased tenants will still be local-check fast, so risk is they dominate

yun: suggestion: leases give higher batch size but lower priority score; also add a max-consecutive-batches cap per-tenant = 3

tessa: config snippet:
```
fairness = {
  deprioritize_threshold_pct: 60,
  deprioritize_window_ms: 200,
  max_consecutive_batches: 3,
}
```

marco: telemetry to add: batch_alloc_by_tenant, consecutive_batches, deprioritize_events

jordan: rollout: sim in harness, then canary 2% with deprioritize on; monitor p95 small-tenant latency and heavy-tenant throughput

yun: also add synthetic token-rotation + policy-update storm test; leases must revoke quickly

tessa: agree. owners: tessa impl, jordan revocation channel, yun telemetry

infra-bot: deploybot: feature-flag console.fairness.deprioritize created by tessa

marco: LGTM — schedule 30m followup after prototype PR

tessa: will do, thanks!
